hypotheses.title: 270-Day Put Implied to 60-Day Parkinson Realized Volatility Ratio (implied_volatility_put_270)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Put implied volatility measures institutional demand for downside tail-risk hedging and crash insurance. Parkinson volatility isolates clean intraday realized high-low price dispersion free of overnight jump noise. Stocks where 270-day put implied volatility is significantly elevated relative to 60-day realized Parkinson volatility encode an harvestable downside variance risk premium (VRP). Dense 60-day backfilling ensures 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000, eliminating single-day weight concentration spikes.
confounders: Binary event catalysts (e.g. pending FDA decisions or hostile takeover bids) causing structural put buying
Sudden illiquidity in deep out-of-the-money put option strikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during catastrophic downside market crashes where out-of-the-money put protection pays off exponentially.

hypotheses.title: 180-Day Put Implied to 60-Day Parkinson Realized Volatility Ratio with Industry Neutralization (implied_volatility_put_180)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluating the 180-day put implied to 60-day Parkinson realized volatility ratio within each broader industry group isolates intra-industry tail risk mispricing while neutralizing sector-level macroeconomic variance. Convex signed_power decile weighting concentrates portfolio capital on equities with the highest variance risk premium, while a 15% 3-day reversal overlay optimizes turnover for maximum platform Fitness.
confounders: Industry-wide regulatory crackdowns distorting downside put options pricing across all peers
Extreme intraday price gaps caused by pre-market earnings surprises
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during synchronized industry-level credit defaults where downside put hedges are in the money.

hypotheses.title: 120-Day Put Implied to 30-Day Parkinson Realized Volatility Ratio (implied_volatility_put_120)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-to-medium 120-day put implied volatility compared against trailing 30-day Parkinson realized volatility captures rapid shifts in downside institutional hedging demand. Equities with high put-to-realized volatility ratios experience systematic volatility decay, generating steady risk-adjusted returns with zero self-correlation against previously approved call-option alphas.
confounders: Company-specific quarterly earnings announcement dates falling inside the 30-day window
Sudden spike in realized borrowing fees for shorted equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during sudden idiosyncratic volatility expansion events where realized volatility overtakes implied put volatility.
